name: Tingzhang Xu
affiliation: Second-year undergraduate · Computer Science · Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications
intro: I work on robot learning and practical systems: humanoid motion tracking, dexterous-hand teleoperation, and perception-to-control pipelines.

research.title: G1 boxing: motion tracking & simulation evaluation
research.background: Adapt human motion to a Unitree G1 humanoid using an existing motion-tracking framework, and evaluate simulated contact forces.
research.contribution: Selected and processed reference motions, iterated reward terms, and extended the evaluation tooling with a fixed-target mode and target-position sweeps. Built on upstream motion-tracking and PPO implementations.
research.stack: Python · MuJoCo · mujoco-warp · RSL-RL / PPO · ONNX
research.result: The project README reports a peak of approximately 303 N in a calibrated fixed-target simulation. This is a simulator contact-force reading, sensitive to target placement and domain randomization; it is not a hardware measurement or a repeated-trial mean.

research.title: Aero Hand: monocular vision teleoperation
research.background: Reproduce the upstream Aero Hand teleoperation pipeline and connect monocular hand tracking to an underactuated robotic hand.
research.contribution: Adapted the runtime and serial I/O, built comparison and calibration tools, and debugged communication failures. Retargeting uses the upstream DexPilot implementation; I do not claim a new retargeting algorithm.
research.stack: Python · OpenCV · MediaPipe · dex_retargeting / DexPilot · MuJoCo · serial I/O
research.result: Hardware operation and calibration are documented in the public repository. The working hardware path uses a Windows single-process loop; ROS 2 simulation work is separate and does not establish a completed ROS 2 hardware bridge.

projects.title: Visual tracking on a Raspberry Pi mobile robot
projects.background: Connect a preconfigured mobile robot to PC-side object detection over a wireless network for visual tracking.
projects.contribution: Designed the system and implemented PC-side and Raspberry Pi-side code, including a framed TCP protocol, JPEG transmission, reconnection handling, and proportional control. Testing and setup were collaborative.
projects.stack: Python · Raspberry Pi 4B · TCP sockets · JPEG · YOLO · proportional control
projects.result: Local experience records report end-to-end latency decreasing from about 500 ms to 150–200 ms after transmission changes. The timing method and test conditions still need review; no public benchmark or repository is linked yet.

projects.title: BUPT information collector
projects.background: Aggregate scattered university notices and surface relevant opportunities without repeatedly notifying the user.
projects.contribution: Implemented source adapters around a common Item schema, incremental deduplication, configurable relevance rules, notification channels, and visible failure diagnostics.
projects.stack: Python · Playwright · YAML · CLI · scheduled tasks
projects.result: The public repository documents the collection-to-notification architecture and operating commands. No user-count, availability, or notification-success-rate claim is made.
